policy: On the first scheduler_abort edge, abort wins over any newly formed good or bad status completion. Code 0x50 is offered exactly once and held. An already offered completion is never overwritten while stalled; after it handshakes, code 0x50 is offered. The metadata FIFO head and bank ownership remain retained.
diagnostics: When status is accepted on the abort edge, completion_received_tag and completion_raw_status preserve that status even though completion_code is 0x50.
scope_limit: Module behavioral and synthesized OOC evidence only; vendor DataMover IP and board behavior are not proven.
